title: Building – Fire and Smoke Alarm Systems for Part 10 Modules April 2012
description: A modular manufacturer built Part 10 industrial relocatable accommodation modules with a smoke detection/alarm arrangement: detectors signal a panel, which triggers separate audible alarms. This differed from the CAN/ULC-S524 fire alarm system and CAN/ULC-S531 smoke alarms required by the acceptable solutions.

refusal.basis: close analog: variance request found not to address objectives and functional statements and not supported by sufficient evidence (appeal of an order)

outcome_summary: Order confirmed: the proposed system did not comply, and the variance request lacked objective/functional-statement analysis and sufficient evidence.
